page.layout: One printed page: running head centred at top with page number at left; title in capitals with subtitle below; a large engraving (emblem picture) in the centre; a four-line verse below the engraving; a catchword-like signature mark "Si" at lower right.

main_text.head: FINIS OMNIVM RERVM adpetit.
main_text.l: Proq; ope suppressi tendunt ad sydera palmas,
Quodq; optant sancti, non procul: (EVGE, veni!) est.

page.notes: The engraving shows an eye within clouds and rays above, a crozier and a sword crossed behind a drum-like barrel with wings, a globe resting on it, and figures with anchors below on a hill. No printed text inside the engraving. The verse is set in italic with long-s forms printed as f; these are transcribed as s. The lower right "Si" is a signature mark.
